items.title: Complete the City of Charleston business registration application
items.authority: City of Charleston Office of the City Collector
items.description: Every business or individual doing business in Charleston must complete the Business Registration Application, whether or not it has a permanent location in the city. Inspection approval from the Planning/Zoning, Building and Fire departments comes first.

items.title: File and pay the City of Charleston Business and Occupation tax
items.authority: City of Charleston Office of the City Collector
items.description: The city levies a Business and Occupation privilege tax on business activity within city limits. Returns and rates are set out in the city's B&O Tax Overview.

items.title: Remit the Charleston City Service Fee withheld from employees
items.authority: City of Charleston Office of the City Collector
items.description: Employers withhold a $3.00 per week City Service Fee from covered employees and remit it quarterly. Self-employed individuals pay it themselves.
items.deadline: Within one month after each calendar quarter ends

items.title: Obtain and renew the Huntington business license
items.description: Anyone conducting business in the City of Huntington must obtain a Huntington Business License. The page gives a $20 fee, notes that fees vary by license type and are not prorated, and says the license term runs July 1 to June 30 with a renewal notice sent around the first of June.

items.title: File the City of Huntington Business & Occupation tax return
items.description: Any business engaged in activity with the object of gaining economic benefit files a quarterly B&O return listing gross income for the period, including a return showing no activity when there was none. The page does not state a rate and notes that the Retail, Restaurant & Others classification was waived on September 13, 2021.
items.deadline: 30 days after each filing period ends (periods end March 31, June 30, September 30 and December 31)
